entry_landing_rate_over_all_code_extent_.note: the denominator is every materialisation inside a code extent, not the kept subset

function_pointer_census.universe: every aligned word of every hash-verified image; a code address materialised by an ADJACENT lui/addiu or lui/ori pair, tracked only within a basic block and only across a delay slot

image_census.census_complete_means: every RESIDENT byte of the image is claimed by an indexed extent or falls in an enumerated gap; every INSTRUCTION-SHAPED WORD decoded inside those gaps has a proved base; and none of them reaches a declared window. It does NOT mean the accesses INSIDE the extents are all resolved -- that is mechanical completeness -- and it does NOT assert semantic ownership of any byte.
image_census.classes_overlap: byte intervals from different classes intersect, so the per-class totals are NOT exclusive buckets and must not be summed; gap_bytes_with_any_evidence is the union
image_census.comparable_universe: analysis/phase4_static_asm_prerequisites.json partitions the same resident loaded-text range for SCUS_942_88 (0x80010000..0x80082800, 468,992 bytes) but against REPAIRED extents rather than static index records, so the two gap totals are comparable and any difference is attributable to the extent source rather than to the universe.

disposition_means.complete: every byte is covered by at least one class
disposition_means.none: no evidence class covers any byte of the gap
disposition_means.partial: some bytes are covered and some are not -- this is NOT an owned gap and must never be counted as one

gap_ownership_evidence.boundary_edge_universe: instructions reachable from every indexed executable extent entry (target-root island records included) by direct branch/jump/call edges, post-call fall-through, and the verified jr targets armed below -- the same universe as the index's CFG. All seven successor kinds are enumerated. Fallthrough from a delay-slot address is suppressed ONLY when the delay slot is that address's sole established execution context; an address that is also entered independently (branch/jump/jr target, not-taken continuation, call return, extent entry) keeps its linear successor.

content_verified_trigonometric_table.basis: complete-table mathematical byte comparison with zero mismatches PLUS instruction-derived reader ranges; either leg alone is insufficient
content_verified_trigonometric_table.extent_rule: only the two exact gap intervals from the receipt are covered; full-table extents are descriptive and do not widen any indexed extent

gap_ownership_evidence.note: the index's CFG imports BOTH verified jr sources -- analysis/phase3_jr_tables.json and the gate-only jr sites from analysis/phase4_static_asm_prerequisites.json -- and promotes decoded target-root islands to census records, so a proved indirect-jump target now lands in claimed bytes unless its island decode fails; a failed decode leaves the gap and is visible here

image_census.instruction_shaped_word_caveat: A word inside an unclaimed region whose ENCODING is a load or store is not a confirmed memory reference. Nothing here shows it is executed, and no direct branch, jump or call edge from reachable code enters any gap in any image. The prior question is who OWNS the region, which is why gap_ownership is recorded per gap with its evidence class and why this count is named for the encoding rather than for a reference.

ownership_classes.content_verified_trig_tail: the tail of the ALREADY content-verified sine table overlapping a third gap: the established formula is re-derived over the overlap by the gap-semantics probe with zero mismatches, clipped to the current gap
ownership_classes.content_verified_trigonometric_table: the complete mathematical table byte-compares with zero mismatches AND a C instruction proof resolves the named readers' bounded effective-address ranges into this exact pre-existing gap. Either fact alone is insufficient; the class never widens an extent
ownership_classes.decoded_jump_table: overlaps a table decoded by tools/phase3_jr_tables.py
ownership_classes.decoded_target_root_island: the index decoded an executable island from that proved target with an explicit stopping proof, without widening any neighbouring extent. Since 2026-08-06 every decoded island is ALSO a first-class census record, so its bytes are claimed and this class is expected empty; a non-empty value would mean an island overlaps an unclaimed gap, which is a defect to investigate, not evidence
ownership_classes.function_entry_pointer_run: a run of >= 3 consecutive aligned words, each exactly a census code/thunk entry of the resident image; the false-positive model (~1e-8 per run) is stated in the gap-semantics receipt. STRUCTURAL evidence: it identifies a pointer table without naming its consumer
ownership_classes.not_directly_reachable: no direct edge from reachable code enters the region. NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT -- an undecoded indirect jump could still land here, so this alone never owns a region.
ownership_classes.read_as_data: statically resolved accesses from analysed code land inside it; the covered-WORD count ships beside the region size so partial coverage is never read as whole-region ownership
ownership_classes.reader_indexed_atan_table: the atan lookup table of atan2_heading: base, entry width and index domain 0..1024 are INSTRUCTION-derived (all twelve indexing/fold words verified by the gap-semantics probe). Its analytic content model is APPROXIMATE -- a fixed 189-entry subset sits exactly +1 over llround(atan), generator unknown -- so this class is one tier below content_verified and says so
ownership_classes.targeted_by_a_proved_indirect_jump: a jr site whose target set the shared gate proved complete lands inside it -- 4 bytes, since it proves an instruction STARTS there and nothing about how far the island runs

resident_partition_reconciliation.meaning: Two independently built partitions of the same resident range OF THE SAME IMAGE FILE -- range endpoints and sha256 both checked, because equal endpoints alone would let a changed image reconcile. Every differing region is attributable to the extent source and none to the universe.

image_census.universe: every byte of every image the static index pins
image_census.universe_note: The partition and the gap sweep run over the RESIDENT range only. A pinned image FILE is not the set of bytes the console loads: a PS-X EXE carries a 2,048-byte header and every level overlay a 4-byte one. Those bytes are file metadata and are reported as nonresident_prefix_bytes, NOT as an unclassified gap -- calling them unclassified would be an error of kind, since unclassified means `resident bytes nobody has owned`.
